name: telephony
description: Telephony platform for AI agents with SMS, WhatsApp, voice calls, TTS/STT, and real-time streaming. Clients resolve their credential and service authority through the @hasna/contracts client chain (per-call: an explicit argument, HASNA_TELEPHONY_API_KEY_OVERRIDE / HASNA_PROFILE / HASNA_TELEPHONY_API_KEY_REF, the macOS Keychain items, ~/.hasna/telephony/config/credentials, then HASNA_TELEPHONY_API_KEY, with the authority defaulting to the fleet gateway), fail closed when hosted without a credential, and reach the on-box SQLite store only through the explicit HASNA_TELEPHONY_LOCAL=1 opt-in (which yields to any resolved credential). The data backend is the only runtime switch on the server: SQLite in the effective telephony data home (~/.hasna/telephony/telephony.db by default, resolved via @hasna/paths; the XDG data home is adopted only once the store is migrated there or HASNA_DATA_HOME is set), or PostgreSQL when a database URL is configured, in which case the serve process reads and writes PostgreSQL directly.
